result.summary: The intersection is characterized by a wide, multi-lane roadway that creates a significant crossing distance for pedestrians. While traffic signals are present for vehicles, there is a notable absence of high-visibility crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and physical refuge areas.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the main thoroughfare exposes pedestrians to traffic for a long duration without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Absence of marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals at a signalized intersection reduces driver awareness and pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Faded Lane Markings
hazards.description: Worn pavement markings can lead to lane drift and unpredictable vehicle movements.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian paths and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide street in two stages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps. A large van is currently obstructing sightlines at the corner, and the pavement shows signs of significant wear and cracking.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large white van is positioned near the corner, blocking the view between pedestrians on the sidewalk and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, white van

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of sloped curb transitions creates a barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic light infrastructure.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all intersection corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near the corner to improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection includes basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks, curb ramps, and signalized crossings. However, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded and the pavement surface is degraded, which may reduce driver awareness and create trip hazards.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are significantly worn, making the crossing less visible to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground across the side street

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Cracking and uneven asphalt surfaces within the intersection area present potential trip hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and throughout the intersection

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with continental or ladder-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pavement resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the intersection to eliminate cracks and uneven surfaces that pose a trip hazard.
